text:
jane_marketing: Heads up  were seeing elevated 5xxs from EU-west after a deploy. Ops says should be narrow but we need to pause the benchmarking launch, hold social copy, and decide what to do about tomorrow's webinar signups. Short callout: need statuspage copy + lead routing plan.

ops-bot: Incident created: EU-west deploy errors (INC-20260408). Severity: medium. https://incidents.internal/INC-20260408

mina_oncall: Investigating now. Backing out the 2-stage router change at :06; initial telemetry shows latency returning to baseline but a few shards still erroring. Will update in 8m. Recommend conservative comms.

jane_marketing: Agreed. Draft statuspage snippet Id publish if ops confirms degrade:  

```
Status: Partial degradation in EU-west impacting a subset of inference requests.
Impact: Intermittent errors/timeouts for some customers; core control-plane and billing unaffected.
Action: Rolling back recent routing change and monitoring; updates every 15 minutes.
```

nate_eng: Fine to use but add a line if we need to escalate later. For now dont call out specific shard configs.

lucy_custops: We should prepare two email stubs: A) Acknowledgement (short), B) Resolved + apology + link to postmortem. Ill queue translations (ES/FR/DE) once we lock text. Also suggest we set the SLA alerting threshold as "watch only" for customers <5m latency spike.

raj_growth: For webinar pipeline: divert new signups to `webinar-hold` tag and create an auto-note on lead record "inc:EU-west". Pause scheduled nurture for that cohort for 48h. Also hold the paid promo pushes.

jane_marketing: Ok locking pause on benchmark blog + socials + paid promo. Rajs ask: please confirm which funnel stage we attach the `webinar-hold` tag to (signup or confirmation?).

raj_growth: Tag at signup level so SDRs can triage pre-confirmed registrants. Create a view `inc_eu_registrants` for SDRs.

mina_oncall: New update: error rate dropped 60% after rollback, still seeing isolated 502s from cache warmup. No customer-facing escalation recommended yet. If error rate <0.5% for two 5m windows mark mitigated.

jane_marketing: Lucy, can you drop the two email stubs here (subject + 3 bullets) and Ill adapt to social-safe language?

lucy_custops: Draft A (ack):
Subject: Were looking into intermittent errors in EU-west
Bullets:
- Brief impact: Some requests may experience errors or delays; not all customers affected.
- What were doing: Rolling back a recent routing change and monitoring closely.
- ETA/next update: We expect an update within 15-30 minutes.

Draft B (resolved):
Subject: Incident resolved  EU-west intermittent errors
Bullets:
- Short summary: The issue was caused by a routing change; rollback completed and systems stable.
- What we did: Restored prior routing and validated request success rates.
- Follow-up: Postmortem will be published in the next 72 hours.

jane_marketing: Perfect. Ill hold the social-ready line: "We're aware of intermittent errors in EU-west; we're on it and will update shortly." No product details.

mina_oncall: ETA next metric update in 10m. If stable mark mitigated and ops-bot will post auto-update.

raj_growth: Also request: tag all webinar leads who signed in the last 2 hours as `possible-affected` so we can deprioritize outreach until we confirm stability.

nate_eng: Agreed on tag. Ops: please notify if any rollback causes downstream latency so marketing can re-open the pause.

jane_marketing: Thanks team 44d holding all launches and nurture. Will publish final status copy once Mina confirms mitigated.

ops-bot: Next automated update scheduled for INC-20260408 in 15 minutes.
